## Checks

- [ ] Tests added or changed: logic, through the window, and security or performance where it matters
- [ ] `tools\run-tests.ps1` passes (clippy, audit and deny included)
- [ ] `README.md` Features table updated, if the app changed
- [ ] `docs/TEST-SCENARIOS.md` regenerated and its summary updated, if tests changed
- [ ] `docs/DECISIONS.md` and `docs/PROGRESS.md` updated for a design decision
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for anything a user would notice
- [ ] No milestone names or decision numbers in code, docs or commit messages
